title: Digital Weighing Scale 10 kg x 1g | Tare Function, LCD Backlit Display, Multi-Unit: g/oz/lb/kg, Battery Powered, Kitchen & Lab Use
description: The Electronic Compact Scale is a reliable and versatile weighing solution designed for a wide range of applications. With a maximum capacity of 10 kg and a precision of 1 g, it is ideal for use in kitchens, offices, pharmacies, grocery shops, industries, and laboratories. The scale features a bright green backlit LCD digital display measuring 67 x 29 mm, making readings easy to view in any lighting condition. It supports multiple units of measurement — Grams (g), Ounces (oz), Pounds (lb), and Kilograms (kg) — allowing you to switch between units effortlessly using the MODE button. The handy TARE function lets you place an empty container on the platform and reset the reading to zero, ensuring accurate net weight measurements every time. The generously sized weighing platform measures 16 x 16 cm, and the overall unit dimensions are 16 x 22 cm. Powered by 2 AA batteries with a convenient low battery indicator, this scale is both portable and practical. Its compact, sturdy design makes it a dependable tool for everyday weighing needs.
